**Zaza Promptly Pricing:**

• **Free:** 5 messages/day with Zara assistant
• **Pro Plan:** €149/year (€12.40/month) - Unlimited messages, full Promptly access, batch exports, priority support
• **Starter Plan:** €99/year (€8.25/month) - Comment Coach, Report Bank, Plan templates

**Risk-free:** 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans. Cancel anytime, no questions asked.

**Free Trial:** You can try Promptly free for 30 days with full Pro features. No credit card required to start.

After trial, choose:
• Starter (€99/year) - Core tools
• Pro (€149/year) - Full suite + priority support

All plans include: EU data protection, no student data stored, secure payments via Stripe.

**Annual vs Monthly:** Annual plans save 15% compared to monthly billing. Annual Pro = €149/year vs €17/month. Annual Starter = €99/year vs €12/month.

Both include the same features, just different billing cycles.
